body_markdown:
EWING, N.J.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


[Universal Display Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Foled.com%2F&esheet=54633811&newsitemid=20261102625489&lan=en-US&anchor=Universal+Display+Corporation&index=1&md5=208192cabca011ca43b7e6028c72266f) (Nasdaq: OLED), a global leader in energy-efficient OLED technologies and materials, today announced its participation in the following investor and industry conferences:


**Investor Conference:**


**Wells Fargo 10th Annual TMT Summit** **Date:** December 7, 2026
**Location:** Rancho Palos Verdes, California
**Presentation Time:** 9:30 a.m. PT*
**Company Representative:** Brian Millard, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer


* A live and archived audio webcast of the investor presentation will be available on the[events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.oled.com%2Fshareholders%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54633811&newsitemid=20261102625489&lan=en-US&anchor=events&index=2&md5=22efd0f11e2f7705723987849f1ddde5) page of the Company’s Investor Relations website at[ir.oled.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.oled.com%2Fshareholders%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54633811&newsitemid=20261102625489&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.oled.com&index=3&md5=b8e93efb2ee1f3b97bb85449d83c7a82) .


**Industry Conferences:**


**2026 World Conference on Innovation and Development in the Display Industry (WCIDDI)** **Date:** November 4, 2026
**Location:** Chengdu, China
**Presenter:** Hao Chen, Deputy Director, Universal Display Corporation China
**Presentation Title:** From Technology Breakthroughs to Local Innovation: Shaping the Next Generation of OLED


**OLED/OPV 40th Anniversary International Symposium** **Date:** November 18, 2026
**Location:** Guangzhou, China
**Plenary Presenter:** Dr. Mike Weaver, Vice President & Deputy Chief Technology Officer of PHOLED R&D
**Plenary Presentation Title:** OLEDs: Illuminating the Future


**International Display Workshops 2026 (IDW 2026)** **Date:** December 3, 2026
**Location:** Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan
**Invited Presenter:** Dr. Nicholas Thompson, R&D Director, New Tech Commercialization
**Invited Presentation Title:** Recent Progress on High Efficiency Blue OLEDs Enabled by Phosphorescent Materials
